techniques.name: Lightning: Spark Needle
techniques.mechanic: A thin fast bolt (3 blocks a tick, 16 range): shocked 4 ticks
techniques.counters: wind jutsu (wind beats lightning), break line of sight, dodge on the charge

techniques.name: Lightning: Stunning Palm
techniques.mechanic: Charge a palm and strike (reach 3): shocked for 10 ticks, chains to one more enemy within 3 blocks
techniques.counters: wind jutsu (wind beats lightning), break line of sight, dodge on the charge

techniques.name: Lightning: False Darkness
techniques.mechanic: A spear of black lightning in a line (20 blocks) that pierces up to three targets
techniques.counters: wind jutsu (wind beats lightning), break line of sight, dodge on the charge

techniques.name: Lightning: Lightning Hound
techniques.mechanic: A hound of lightning that runs the target down (homing 0.4); splits on a dodge
techniques.counters: wind jutsu (wind beats lightning), break line of sight, dodge on the charge

techniques.name: Lightning: Thunder Cage
techniques.mechanic: A ring of crackling posts (radius 5) for 120 ticks: anyone touching its edge is shocked; you can stand inside
techniques.counters: wind jutsu (wind beats lightning), break line of sight, dodge on the charge

techniques.name: Lightning Blade
techniques.mechanic: Charge 20 ticks (the hand crackles; you are slowed), then a straight dash of 12 blocks that breaks through a guard, a parry or a barrier
techniques.counters: sidestep at the last moment; wind jutsu; a substitution

techniques.name: Lightning: Armour
techniques.mechanic: Shrouds the body in lightning (shrouded, 3 chakra a second): +30% speed and attack speed, physical damage taken -30%, opens Lightning Body
techniques.counters: wind jutsu (wind beats lightning), break line of sight, dodge on the charge

techniques.name: Lightning: Kirin
techniques.mechanic: Calls a bolt from a storm cloud onto the target, instantly (no projectile). Needs rain, a thunderstorm or a fire user's storm cloud
techniques.counters: be under a roof; a lightning rod (earth spire)
